question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Commence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Start.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Commence"** means to begin or start something. It is often used to describe the beginning of a formal event, process, or action. (शुरू करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The meeting will commence at 10 a.m.
 
 
 
• The word **"Start"** is a synonym of "Commence." It also means to begin or initiate something. (आरंभ करना)
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to start the project immediately after receiving approval.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Commence"** is **"Start."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Subvert **(विनाश करना): To undermine the power or authority of an established system or institution.

 
 
• **Example:** The group tried to subvert the government by spreading false information.
 
 
 
• **Exert **(प्रयास करना): To apply force, influence, or pressure.
 
 
• **Example:** You need to exert more effort if you want to achieve your goals.
 
 
 
• **Escort **(संग-साथ देना): To accompany someone for protection, guidance, or as a mark of courtesy.
 
 
• **Example:** The security team was assigned to escort the VIP to the event.
